decisions.title: Local check-ci green without native matrix
decisions.reason: check-ci is explicitly workflow lint/contract only; .github/workflows/ci.yml native jobs independently execute canonical Make; MASTERPLAN and local receipts explicitly leave hosted/native pending. No falsely claimed native execution.

decisions.title: Manual gate receipts lack artifact binding
decisions.reason: Every gate is bound to source/version/run/manifest (promote.sh:43); cask identity is independently hash-bound in candidate-run, owner acceptance/authorization and fresh verify-candidate/check-cask (lines 19-20,34,53-57,65-66). All CLI/TUI/startup reports are separately hash-checked and their binary/compiler/source/sample identities validated (75-96). Extra manual duplicate hash fields do not demonstrate physical execution; actual native/cask proof remains an explicit maintainer gate.

decisions.title: Artifact API digest never gates download
decisions.reason: candidate.sh:126-129 verifies every payload, manifest, cask and candidate-run subject certificate against exact run/attempt/source. Altered bytes cannot pass those cryptographic subject checks. Transport ZIP metadata is explicitly not an acceptance claim (receipt transport field); producer verifies full extracted inventory. No demonstrated accepted wrong payload.

decisions.title: Verify-candidate assumes local tree is artifact
decisions.reason: candidate.sh:90-101 and 126-129 hash-bind candidate-run/manifest/cask and verify every subject against one exact signed run/attempt. Mixed-run or changed bytes fail those checks regardless of how the directory was extracted; ZIP equality is not the shipped-byte contract.

decisions.title: Provenance attestation omits signer-digest binding
decisions.reason: The immutable hosted identity check binds GITHUB_SHA/GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA to requested RELEASE_SHA (candidate.sh:19); pinned attestation action signs in that run, and maintainer verifier explicitly requires signer/source/run certificate identity. Future default divergence is speculation; no current defect demonstrated.

soft_buckets: Intentional external gates retained as scope limits; hypothetical compromised-runner/ZIP metadata scenarios and duplicated testing concerns rejected, not recycled as residual defects.
